_note: Motion speeds of the sort loop by profile (sort_any.py --profile NAME). Joint speeds and accelerations are in normalized joint units per second (and per second squared), as the motion server plans its ramps. The motion server never exceeds limits.hard_speed and limits.hard_accel.

limits._note: upper bounds the motion server enforces for every command

safe._note: the speeds of the first robot runs

demo._note: short cycle: faster transit, hover and descents and higher acceleration; the last grasp millimetres stay slow
